policy: Exact byte hashes below apply to the retained artifacts. An official source cited but not retained is never represented as hash-verified. No source or ID is inferred from the ADM suffix.

sources.title: INE Angola, Resultados Definitivos do Recenseamento Geral da População e Habitação 2024
sources.license: INE report; no explicit open redistribution grant verified. Do not commit PDF; URL and hash are restoration/identity instructions.
sources.reproduced_findings: INE says census enumeration used former 18-province DPA but final results were adjusted under Law 14/24 (2024-09-05) to 21 provinces, 326 municipalities and 378 communes. INE specifically describes territorial changes in Cacuaco/Sequele and Cazenga/Hoji-ya-Henda.
sources.supports: Need to remap 2018 municipality features to current territorial identities; identical names are not a successor proof.
sources.does_not_support: The 2024 official district/municipality boundary geometries themselves.

sources.title: National Statistical Office of Malawi, 2018 Population and Housing Census Main Report
sources.license: Official NSO report; no explicit open redistribution grant verified. Do not commit PDF; restore from exact URL and verify this SHA-256.
sources.reproduced_findings: Table A3 groups 28 district names under the Northern/Central/Southern regions and lists Blantyre City, Lilongwe City, Mzuzu City, and Zomba City separately as urban-only rows.
sources.supports: Historical 28-district roster/region crosswalk and the existence of separately tabulated cities.
sources.does_not_support: A decision whether the four cities are separate administrative districts, or polygon validity/completeness.

sources.title: OCHA IM Toolbox, P-codes: Malawi COD-AB and COD-PS alternative P-code structures
sources.retention: Not retained; cite and restore through URL. Hash of canonical page bytes not obtained.
sources.finding: OCHA documents the competing 28- and 32-unit ADM2 models, the four-city distinction, lack of consensus in 2018, and the decision to use 32-unit COD-AB pending census evidence. The page is source history/context, not a legal adjudication.

sources.title: Malawi NSO/OCHA COD-AB version 02, valid from 2023-04-05 (identified in published mwmapdata source notes)

sources.finding: Published dataset documentation identifies the authoritative source as National Statistics Office Malawi, distributed through OCHA HDX, version 02, valid from 2023-04-05. A derivative data package documents 32 level-2 units including the four city districts.

Supports separate administrative context, not the source polygon boundary.

sources.finding: New bounded child, status blocked pending #411. Exact 157 issue-owned non-Cabinda IDs; the four out-of-scope Cabinda IDs stay with #896.

The original retained ADM2 layer contains 32 features under three regional parents. A reproducible name-only candidate roster screen matches all 28 pinned 2020 geoBoundaries names (Nkhata Bay/Nkhatabay normalizes as a spelling-form match) and leaves four city-named COD-AB units unmatched. This does not establish identity, legal/statistical tier equivalence, parent correctness, boundary equivalence or correctness. #1045 owns source-semantic adjudication and geometric comparison.
